notes: Access route: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered. Platform: Shopify (rockettstgeorge-live.myshopify.com). CRITICAL FINDING: the /collections.json 'products_count' field is dramatically inflated on this store, worse than prior batches' Shopify findings -- e.g. Art Prints field said 230 but the live collection has exactly 1 product (confirmed by rendered page 'You're viewing 1-1 of 1 products' AND '1 Result' filter panel text); Ceiling Lights field said 129 vs 37 actual (3.5x); Wall Mirrors field said 120 vs 37 actual; Quirky Wall Decor field said 211 vs 95 actual. Every qty below was instead obtained by exhaustively paging /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 and counting unique product IDs (a single page returned in every case, i.e. the page was not truncated, confirming exhaustion), then cross-checked against the rendered 'You're viewing X of Y products' / 'N Results' header text for 5 categories (Mirrors, Vases, Decorative Accessories, Ceiling Lights, Table Lamps) which matched exactly. Evidence strings below name this method as 'products.json exhaustion'. EXCLUDED as non-decor / functional / textile / furniture / storage roll-ups: Bathroom (160 nominal; live sample is majority bath mats [textile], soap dispensers/toothbrush holders/storage canisters/toilet-roll holder [bathroom hardware/storage, excluded per Rule 0.4] -- its handful of genuine decor items, e.g. a small hanging mirror, are already covered by the Mirrors collection); Kitchen Accessories (majority functional kitchenware: storage tins, oven gloves, aprons, tea towels, nutcrackers, bottle openers -- its few decorative serving plates/trays are already covered by Fruit Bowls & Serveware / Plates); Bar & Party Accessories (majority bar tools and party consumables -- its glassware/champagne-glass items duplicate the Glassware collection); Kitchen Storage, Utility & Storage, Doormats & Rugs, Umbrellas & Umbrella Stands, Soft Furnishings (Cushions/Throws/Bedding/Bath Mats & Towels/Curtains), Clothing & Accessories, Placemats & Coasters (current live inventory is 2 items, both coasters, no placemats -- excluded as a functional/table-linen-adjacent micro-category, not on the approved decor list), Faux Plants & Dried Grasses (standing exclusion), Wallpaper (standing exclusion), Tin Ceiling Tiles (building material), all Furniture nodes, the entire Gifts hub (Holiday & Gift exclusion; its sub-nodes are occasion/price/person facet re-cuts of the same catalogue), Jewellery & Trinket Trays (majority jewellery, not home decor), Garden Furniture and Outdoor Cushions & Garden Rugs (furniture/textile), Garden Accessories (majority outdoor cushions, table clamps, novelty hand fans -- its planters and 2 lighting items are already covered by Vases/Planters and Outdoor Lighting), the 4 'Shop By Room' collections (Living Room/Bedroom/Dining Room/Home Office -- these are broad mixed furniture+textile+decor marketing roll-ups, not a genuine 'Lighting by Room' structure under Rule 0.1), and 'Shop By Colour' (colour facet, explicitly excluded). DE-DUPLICATION (product-ID overlap verified, not name-based): dropped Decorative Mirrors (94% of its 32 products already in the kept Mirrors collection of 39) and Wall Mirrors (81% overlap with Mirrors; also a homepage promo tile, not a mega-menu nav node) as near-duplicate re-cuts of Mirrors -- kept Mirrors (39) as the single authoritative leaf, which itself already spans wall/bathroom/convex/framed mirror sub-types per its own on-page filter panel ('Wall Mirrors / Mirrored Wall Art / Bathroom Mirrors'), satisfying Rule 0.3 without a separate row. Dropped Chandeliers (67% of its 3 products already in Ceiling Lights' 37) as a near-empty subset. Dropped Animal Lights (a cross-cutting decor-motif facet: its 7 products are already fully accounted for inside Table Lamps, Floor Lamps and Wall Lights). Dropped Plug-In Wall Lights (100% of its 5 products already inside Wall Lights' 11). Dropped Easyfit Pendant Light Shades (84% of its 25 products already inside the kept Lampshades collection of 27; the residual is Easyfit-specific ceiling-shade glass already separately visible via Ceiling Lights). Dropped 'Decorative Accessories' (quirky-unusual-decorative-accessories-for-the-home) as a leaf -- its 176 products are a superset roll-up containing 100% of Vases/Planters, 87% of Candles, and 95% of Ornaments & Treasures -- and instead used it as the PARENT grouping row for those three plus Books & Bookends, matching the site's own mega-menu nesting. KEPT WITH DOCUMENTED OVERLAP (Rule 0.6 -- genuine distinct nav branches, not pure re-cuts): Lampshades (27) and Ceiling Lights (37) share 59%/43% overlap (a shade can be sold both as a standalone accessory and as part of/matching a fixture) -- both kept as they are separate first-level mega-menu categories with materially different core content. Fruit Bowls & Serveware (29) and Plates, Bowls & Cutlery (22) share moderate 45%/59% overlap -- kept both as distinct named nav categories. Candles & Candle Holders (39) includes 1 reed diffuser (home fragrance, normally excluded) commingled and inseparable at the URL level; the remaining 38 are candle holders/candelabra/sconces/lanterns, zero scented candles found. Books & Bookends (3) includes 1 actual book title alongside 2 bookend/book-stand decor items, inseparable at the URL level. Plates, Bowls & Cutlery (22) includes several cutlery-set items (flatware, normally excluded) commingled with the majority-decor plates/bowls; no separate cutlery-only URL exists on this site to split them out. 'Lightbulbs & Fairy Lights' node currently lists 2 products, both fairy lights (decorative string lights) and zero light bulbs -- kept per Rule 0 (product type, not node name, governs); renamed to 'Fairy Lights' to reflect actual live contents. No Lighting-by-Room, Vanity, or Bathroom-lighting sub-tree exists on this site (Rule 0.1 checked and not applicable -- lighting here is organised purely by fixture type, and the one outdoor/room-adjacent node, Outdoor Lighting, is included).
